tool_args.rationale: The branch probe established that stronger sink gradients suppress transfer, but every paid row is a single endpoint at H = 0.6 and x_now = 0.25. The trajectory batch can distinguish dynamic two-layer exchange from an algebraic saturation law before committing to fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A smooth saturation law fits the paid rows within tolerance, but those rows cannot distinguish an instantaneous transfer law from a transient observed at H = 0.6.
The mechanism notes motivate this model, but all seven rows use the same horizon and initial state, leaving the exchange and loss rates unresolved.
The acquired branch rows already establish sink inhibition. More endpoint measurements of that kind would not resolve the transient dynamics.
